en.decision_text: Having pacified Hebei, I now hold the Emperor and command the nobles in his name. Liu Bei, entrenched at Xinye with fewer than five thousand troops, has gained Zhuge Liang as his strategist — left unchecked, he will become a grave threat. I must strike before his wings fully spread, dispatching a superior force to crush him. Meanwhile, Liu Biao lies gravely ill, and the hearts of Jing Province waver; I shall send envoys to pressure the Xiangyang gentry into surrender, aiming to take Jingzhou without a battle.

commands.reasoning: Liu Bei's forces are weak — a ten-to-one advantage ensures a swift capture of Xinye. Wancheng is the nearest staging point.
With Liu Biao gravely ill, diplomatic pressure may force Jingzhou's surrender without bloodshed.
Develop the capital Xuchang's agricultural colonies to secure grain supplies for the southern campaign.

zh.decision_text: 孤已定河北，挟天子以令诸侯。刘备屯新野，虽兵微将寡，然得诸葛亮为辅，必为后患。今当趁其羽翼未丰，遣上将率雄师讨之，一举荡平。刘表病重，荆州人心动摇，可遣使恫吓，迫其归降。另命许昌屯田积谷，以备南征大军粮草之需。

commands.reasoning: 刘备兵力仅五千，以十倍之师自宛城南下，可确保一役而克，铲除心腹之患。
刘表病笃，荆州内惧外患，施以兵威可使其不战而降，或至少震慑其勿援刘备。
许昌为根本之地，屯田发展可充实府库，为后续南征提供持续补给。

en.decision_text: With meager resources, I hold Xinye for now. Cao Cao's power looms like a tiger watching its prey — we cannot face him directly. I must ally with Sun Quan to the east, striking Cao from two fronts like a pair of horns; internally, I will develop agriculture, stockpile grain, and pacify the people. Spring planting approaches — it is time to encourage farming and let the people recover. I will also send envoys to Jiangdong to seal an alliance against external threats, and recruit able-bodied men to strengthen our garrison. Thus, we can seize opportunity when the moment comes, or hold firm and wait for the right season.

commands.reasoning: Cao Cao's strength is overwhelming — allying with Sun Quan in the east creates a north-south pincer and relieves pressure on Xinye.
Develop agriculture and economy in Xinye to stockpile grain for a long defensive campaign and future recruitment.
Xinye faces Cao's army directly with only five thousand troops — recruiting a thousand more bolsters the garrison without overtaxing our grain supplies.

zh.decision_text: 玄德公屯兵新野，兵微将寡，然心存仁义，不忍劳民。曹操势大，虎视荆襄，新野首当其冲。今当内修政理，外结盟友。闻卧龙凤雏，天下奇才，可使人寻访，延揽经纶济世之士。同时，宜练兵屯田，充实军资，更遣使荆州，固好于刘荆州，缓图联吴抗曹之策。

commands.reasoning: 兵力单薄，需招募新兵以加强新野防守，但仁慈为本，量力而行，征募千五，不扰民生。
发展新野农桑，安辑百姓，充实粮草，为持久之计。
刘表为汉室宗亲，现居襄阳，与备友善。结盟可互为犄角，共御曹操，亦可得荆州之援。

en.decision_text: Cao Cao's might is vast, but with Hebei still unsettled, he dares not lightly cross the Yangtze. Liu Biao is on his deathbed, and chaos will soon engulf Jing Province — a heaven-sent opportunity. I shall govern wisely at home and forge alliances abroad. First, I will fortify Chaisang as the springboard for our westward advance. I will send Lu Su to Liu Bei to bind us as close as lips and teeth; Zhou Yu shall drill the navy at Chaisang. When the autumn harvest fills our granaries, we shall seize Changsha and secure control over the entire Yangtze.

commands.reasoning: Ally with Liu Bei to tie down Cao Cao's forces, creating a strategic opening for our westward expansion.
Chaisang is the forward base for our western campaign — developing its economy will fund the coming operations.
The Jiangdong navy is our greatest strength — expanding the fleet secures command of the river for our assault on Jing Province.
Transfer forces from Jianye to Chaisang, assembling thirty thousand naval and land troops for next quarter's attack on Changsha.

zh.decision_text: 孤承父兄基业，雄踞江东六郡。今曹操势大，早晚必图江南，不可不备。刘表老迈，荆州内乱，江夏黄祖乃吾仇雠，当先除此獠，夺其地以为北进之跳板。刘备暂居新野，虽弱然有英雄之志，可遣使结好，共抗曹操。内事则委张昭，外事托周瑜，练兵屯粮，静待天时。

commands.reasoning: 江夏为荆州东大门，黄祖与我血仇，且曹操南下必先取荆州，先发制人可抢得战略要地。柴桑屯兵充足，水陆并进可一举破敌。
刘备虽暂居新野，然有关张之勇，且据荆州之侧，联之可互为犄角，牵制曹操。
建业乃都城，广积粮草，兴修水利，充实府库，为后续战事提供保障。
江东以水师称雄，攻取江夏后需巩固水防，备曹操南下。柴桑为水军基地，就近征募得习水之卒。
